page.overview:
Who is American Herring Gull?

The (Larus smithsonianus) is a large found in North America.

Adults are white with gray back and wings, black wingtips with white spots, and pink legs. Immature birds are gray-brown and are darker and more uniform than European herring gulls, with a darker tail. As is common with other gulls, they are colloquially referred to simply as seagulls.

A pair of American herring gulls flew near a great white shark that caught a sea lion just before they both get swallowed by the Mosasaurus.

When Ben and Darius were lead out by Sammy, Bumpy the Ankylosaurus is seen playfully chasing three American herring gulls.
